papers.title: Frontoparietal functional connectivity underlies top-down attention in mild cognitive impairment
papers.reason: The paper directly concerns frontoparietal connectivity supporting top-down attention in mild cognitive impairment, making it highly relevant to neural mechanisms of executive attention.
